title: Padding commutes with source translation
statement: Let $k,m$ be natural numbers, let $l$ be a list of sources for $k$ tapes, and let $\rho$ assign natural numbers to the eleven registers. Translate each source to its associated Boolean circuit bit source. Translating the list obtained by padding $l$ to length at least $m$ with false constants gives the translated list $l$, followed by $m-|l|$ false constants.
